translations.web: But as one was cutting down a tree, the ax head fell into the water. Then he cried, and said, “Alas, my master! For it was borrowed.”
translations.bsb: As one of them was cutting down a tree, the iron axe head fell into the water. “Oh, my master,” he cried out, “it was borrowed!”
translations.kjv: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.
translations.asv: But as one was felling a beam, the axe-head fell into the water; and he cried, and said, Alas, my master! for it was borrowed.
